senses.gloss:
m. (-शः)
1 A country, a region, whether inhabited or uninhabited.
2 A part, a portion.
3 Institute, ordinance.
E.
दिश to point, to show, affix घञ्.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Who or what shows, points out, describes, &c.
m. (-कः)
1 A ruler, a governor.
2 A guide.
3 An instructor.
E.
दिश to command, affix ण्वुल्.

f. (-री)
A mode of music, a Rāgiṇī.

mfn. (-विद्)
Knowing what is suited to time and place.
E.
देश, काल time, and विद् who knows.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Regulated by time and place.
E.
देश, काल time, व्यवस्थित determined.

mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं)
Considered locally, judged as to place.
E.
देश, and दृष्ट seen.

m. (-र्म्मः)
Local law, the law or usage of the country.
E.
देश, and धर्म्म moral merit.

n. (-पं)
Propriety, fitness.
E.
देश ordinance, रूप form, essence.

m. (-रः)
Local usage, custom of the country.
E.
देश, and व्यवहार practice.

n. (-रः)
1 A foreign country.
2 Longitude or difference of longitude.
E.
देश, and अन्तर different.

mfn. (-क्षः-क्षा-क्षं)
Spying, searching out a land.
E.
देश, and अपेक्ष who inspects.

m. (-कः)
1 A traveller, a stranger, a sojourner.
2 A Guru or spiritual teacher.
E.
देश a country, &c. ठक् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Directed, commanded.
2 Shown.
3 Advised, instructed.
E.
दिश to show, and क्त affix, with इट् inserted.

mfn. (-शी-शिनी-शि)
1 Of or belonging to a country.
2 Showing, instructing, guiding.
f. (-नी)
The index or forefinger.
E.
दिश to show, affix णिनि or देश, and इनि aff.

mfn. (-श्यः-श्या-श्यं)
1 What is proper to be proved or ordered.
2 Local.
3 Present at any transaction, on the spot.
n. (-श्यं)
1 The postulate, the statement or exhibition of a question or argument.
2 The fact or charge to be proved or substantiated.
m. (-श्यः)
An eyewitness of any thing, one who was on the spot.
E.
दिश to show or command, affix ण्यत्; or देश, and यत् aff.

mfn. (-ष्णुः-ष्णुः-ष्णु)
1 Difficult of subjection, untameable, intractable, ungovernable.
2 Liberal in giving, a donor.
m. (-ष्णुः)
A washerman.
E.
दा to give, &c. इष्णुच् Uṇādi aff.
